snippet.title: Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection – Announcement Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
snippet.description:
Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 in 2026!

Twin Rathalos born in a twist of fate. Their appearance sets the stage for a new tale of Riders and Rathalos to unfold.

Become a Rider, bond with monsters, and explore the vibrant world of Monster Hunter in this next evolution of the Monster Hunter Stories series.

#MHStories3 #NintendoSwitch2 #NintendoDirect

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
